en-US.creationMode.inspiration.desc: Upload one inspiration image and borrow its atmosphere, composition, and visual tone to create a new product image.
en-US.creationMode.smart.desc: AI analyzes the product images and quickly generates eye-catching product creatives with strong atmosphere.
en-US.description: Upload product images and let AI analyze the product to quickly generate eye-catching, high-atmosphere product creatives.

en-US.section.productImages.help: Support product images of all categories. The more complete the set, the better the generation effect.
en-US.showcaseType.model.desc: The generated image includes a real human model to show how the product looks when worn or used with human interaction.
en-US.showcaseType.scene.desc: The generated image contains no human model and focuses on the product's atmosphere and placement in a real scene.
en-US.upload.inspirationImage.help: Upload one inspiration image. AI will borrow its atmosphere, composition, and camera expression without copying its product subject directly.
